description: Check an IBAN's format, its country-specific length and its mod-97 check digits, and return it formatted in groups of four. Use before saving bank details or paying out. Example: iban=SE45 5000 0000 0583 9825 7466. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: validate_iban
title: Validate an IBAN
